name: vid2-intro
title: vid2-intro — a keynote-style product film
summary: A quiet 36-second product film: one sentence per scene, a typed command, verbs lit one at a time, a rolling number and a piano cue.
techniques: keynote grammar: black canvas, two greys and white
long ease-out arrivals with a focus pull
verbs lit one at a time
80 BPM piano cue, one bar = 3 s
goodFor: developer tool intro with a real command

needs.note: runs music2-gen for the piano cue

edit.what: the seven sentences, the command, the verbs and the number

steps.run: mkdir -p media && npx -y music2-gen render music/vid2-intro.song.json -o media/music.wav
